title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 40,047 Official Dossiers Across 37 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 40,047 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 863 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 37 active jurisdictions: United States (15,327 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (2,799 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,379 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (4,617 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,974 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (182 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,270 dossiers | Catalog), International (1,048 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (167 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (189 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (67 dossiers | Catalog), France (436 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (71 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (76 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (377 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (25 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (90 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (35 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (49 dossiers | Catalog), China (31 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (150 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (40 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (39 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (14 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (32 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
